subject: Re: Post-discovery: Technical deep-dive & runbook review

Date: Tue, 02 Sep 2025 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: technical next step and deep-dive

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the discovery call this morning — that was helpful. The team here (Tim + ops) wants to schedule the technical deep-dive you mentioned so we can sync on deployment topology, SLOs, and the runbook you referenced.

A few constraints from our side:
- Prefer mornings PT (9–11am) next week
- We have a 30–45 minute slot in mind (engineer-only first half, then product stakeholders)
- We'll want the initial runbook draft ahead of the call so our infra lead can review offline

Can you propose 2–3 time options and share the runbook draft? Also please include any pre-read or items we should surface before the session.

Thanks — Alyssa
Alyssa Nguyen
Head of Platform, Crescent Labs
alyssa@crescentlabs.com

Hi Alyssa — great to hear. Appreciate the constraints; attached is a first-pass runbook (redwood-runbook-v1.pdf) that covers topology options, operator checklist, and suggested pre-read.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Wed 2025-09-03 09:30–10:15 (preferred: quick engineer exchange + stakeholder wrap)
- Thu 2025-09-04 10:00–10:45
- Fri 2025-09-05 09:00–09:45

Plan: Ben (solutions engineer) will run the first 25–30 minutes, then Soojin (pre-sales PM) and I will join for the final 10–15 to cover rollout/next steps. If you want a longer cadence we can open more time, but starting with a tight 45m helps us focus.

I've CC'd Ben and Soojin to confirm internal availability and to add any prep notes.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

All — I can do Wed 9:30 or Thu 10:00. Prefer Wed since I can set up a short demo of KV-cache behavior with your sample sequence lengths (Alyssa — those numbers in crescent-scope.csv were super helpful).

Pre-read ask from my side: can you flag any regulatory constraints (data residency, retention) we should not show in the demo? If so, we'll scrub examples.

I'll prepare a 10-minute demo + 10-minute Q&A focused on request/response latency, batching, and fallback routing.

Cheers,
Ben

ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Quick update — our calendar just shifted. Ben is confirmed for Wed 9:30 but I have a conflict at 9:40 that blocks the stakeholder window. Two suggestions:
1) Keep Wed 9:30–10:15 as an engineer-heavy session (Ben + Marissa) and run a 15m stakeholder follow-up Tue 09/09 09:15–09:30 PT.
2) Move the full session to Thu 10:00–10:45 PT so we can ensure both engineer and stakeholder coverage in the same meeting.

Alyssa — which would you prefer? If you want option 2 I can send an updated invite and include a short agenda.

Also: Ben will upload a short demo recording and a minimal reproducible example (gist) to the shared Drive after the run so your infra team can run it offline.

Thanks,
Soojin

Thanks — option 2 works best for us (consolidated meeting). Please send updated invite for Thu 2025-09-04 10:00–10:45 PT and include a 3–point agenda: demo, topology tradeoffs, integration checklist.

Also — we reviewed the runbook quickly and left a few comments inline (will send a short doc with questions). If you can pre-address the retention/data-flow question Ben asked, that would help us move faster.

See you Thu.

Best,
Alyssa
